newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Landslide kills three in Colombian squatter camp.
newsitem.headline: Landslide kills three in Colombian squatter camp.

text.p: A landslide killed three people and injured at least three others in a squatters' settlement in southwest Colombia early on Saturday, Red Cross officials said.

Rescue workers said more people could be buried under huge piles of mud and rock, which destroyed two shacks on an illegally occupied plot of land on the outskirts of Cali, Colombia's second largest city. The cause of the landslide was not immediately known, a Red Cross spokesman said.
